name: Looper
about: Loop of layers from the microphone
hint: Tap — record the first loop. Tap again — the loop plays, then every tap adds a layer. Hold — undo a layer. Headphones: without them the mic hears the speaker.
hintMore: Tap — new layer on top. Hold — undo the last one.
hintShort: Tap — record, again — loop, then — layers
metro: With metronome: one-bar count-in, length in whole bars
monOn: Microphone in the speakers — better with headphones
saved: Mix saved to the media library
err.sound: Sound did not start — tap again
help.what: Looper: record a loop and play over it.
help.1: One button: record → loop → layer → done.
help.2: With the metronome — count-in, length in whole bars.
help.3: Hold the button — undo a layer; four loops below.
help.4: Bluetooth pedal: Space or PageDown — button, PageUp — stop.
layerDrag: Layer {n}: drag — shift, tap — layer window
help.5: Reels and tracks: drag — shift the layer, tap — layer window (bounds, fine shift, sound), ‹ › — by a millisecond (hold — faster).
editHint: Loop window: drag the middle — shift, the corners — trim.
replaceOn: Replace: the old take is erased as you play
rowTap: {name}: tap — on/off from the next bar, hold — menu
tempoHint: Tempo and meter follow the metronome
partsHint: “+” adds a part (drums, notes, chords) or a recording from the library. The button below plays the loop, then records a layer on top.
pieceHint: A sample or short sound: “Beat” or “Bar” with repeat. Longer material: “Loop”. A single hit at the start: “Once”.
err.lenLayers: Layers have a different length — remove them first
clickLeftOn: Click goes to the left ear while the loop plays
capArm: From the next loop start — play piano, pads, glider, theremin or a MIDI keyboard
